card.name: Word endings -ant and -ants
card.fires_on: The ending -ant or -ants completing a noun, mostly in irritant, also reactants, attendants and adjutant. It fires after the stem has been read, as the word ends.

modes.label: Irritant endings
modes.description: The ending -ant or -ants closes the word irritant in skin or mucosal warnings.
modes.example: WARNINGS: Podophyllin is a powerful caustic and severe irrit<<ant>>. Keep away from the eyes; if

modes.label: Other -ant nouns
modes.description: The ending -ant or -ants closes a person or chemistry noun such as adjutant, reactants or attendants.
